deadline.value: Applications close January 8, 2027 at 3:00 PM CET for the single 2027 intake, with program start on 15 September 2027.
deadline.quote: Deadline for applicants: January 8, 2027 (3:00 PM CET)

gre_subject.value: No GRE of any kind is required, so the subject test is not needed either.
gre_subject.quote: Do I need to submit a TOEFL/IELTS or GRE score? | No, you do not.

supervisor.value: No supervisor agreement is needed to apply: admission is by committee, and students start unaffiliated and join a group after rotations.
supervisor.quote: All ISTA students start as unaffiliated, i.e. they are not yet part of a research group.

also.quote: the names of the professor(s) they wish to work with at the time of application

funding.value: All admitted PhD students are fully funded at internationally competitive salary levels until their thesis defense.
funding.quote: All our PhD students are fully funded, at internationally competitive salary levels

also.quote: All students making reasonable progress are fully funded until the time of their thesis defense.

entry_route.value: Applicants with a bachelor's or a master's degree in these fields are encouraged to apply; a bachelor's is the minimum entry requirement.
entry_route.quote: The minimum formal entry requirement is a Bachelor degree.

also.quote: Students with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in biology, chemistry, neuroscience, mathematics, computer science, physics, data science and scientific computing, astronomy, earth science and related areas are encouraged to apply.
